title: Gerente de Contas Sudeste
description:
About the role

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Contas Foodservice para impulsionar o crescimento dos negócios da Kerry na Região Sudeste do Brasil por meio da gestão estratégica de distribuidores de foodservice e operadores de vending machine. Esta posição terá papel fundamental na aceleração do sell-out, expansão da base de clientes e desenvolvimento de planos de negócio sustentáveis, atuando de forma próxima aos parceiros comerciais e equipes de vendas em campo.

Além da responsabilidade comercial, o profissional liderará diretamente um colaborador, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento da equipe, execução da estratégia comercial e alcance dos objetivos de crescimento da região.

Key responsibilities

  • Gerenciar e desenvolver uma carteira de distribuidores estratégicos de foodservice e operadores de vending machine na Região Sudeste do Brasil.
  • Liderar e desenvolver diretamente um profissional da equipe comercial, estabelecendo metas, acompanhando performance e promovendo seu crescimento profissional.
  • Construir e executar Joint Business Plans (JBP), definindo estratégias, metas e planos de crescimento com os distribuidores.
  • Monitorar e impulsionar indicadores-chave de desempenho do canal, incluindo:
  • Sell-out
  • Cobertura geográfica
  • Positivação de clientes
  • Ticket médio
  • Margem e rentabilidade
  • Mix e desenvolvimento de categorias
  • Desenvolver iniciativas comerciais e programas de incentivo para acelerar resultados e aumentar a produtividade dos distribuidores.
  • Realizar visitas constantes a campo, acompanhando rotas e apoiando diretamente as equipes comerciais dos distribuidores.
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão da carteira de clientes e crescimento da participação de mercado no Sudeste.
  • Prospectar novos distribuidores e desenvolver novos negócios para as marcas de Foodservice da Kerry.
  • Treinar e capacitar equipes de vendas dos distribuidores sobre produtos, portfólio e oportunidades de mercado.
  • Trabalhar de forma consultiva com clientes e distribuidores para desenvolver soluções alinhadas às necessidades dos segmentos de foodservice.
  • Gerenciar e expandir projetos junto a operadores estratégicos de vending machine, garantindo crescimento sustentável, rentabilidade e aumento da participação de mercado.
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com contas-chave do segmento de vending machine e identificar oportunidades de inovação e expansão do canal.
  • Colaborar com as áreas de Supply Chain, Customer Care, Marketing e demais áreas internas para assegurar excelência na execução comercial e assertividade de forecast.
  • Participar de eventos, Innovation Days e iniciativas estratégicas voltadas ao desenvolvimento do canal Foodservice.

Qualifications and skills

  • Mínimo de 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área comercial, preferencialmente nos segmentos de Foodservice, Ingredientes, Café, Panificação, Confeitaria ou canais indiretos.
  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial, Engenharia de Alimentos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência na gestão e desenvolvimento de distribuidores de foodservice.
  • Experiência comprovada no canal de vending machine é mandatória (must-have).
  • Histórico consistente de resultados em gestão de contas estratégicas e desenvolvimento de negócios no segmento de vending machine.
  • Experiência prévia em liderança de pessoas, desenvolvimento de equipes e gestão de performance.
  • Experiência comprovada na construção e execução de Joint Business Plans (JBP).
  • Vivência na gestão de indicadores comerciais e desenvolvimento de estratégias de crescimento.
  • Forte atuação em campo e experiência acompanhando equipes comerciais e distribuidores.
  • Conhecimento avançado de gestão de canais indiretos e distribuidores.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver estratégias de sell-out e expansão de mercado.
  • Conhecimento de indicadores de distribuição e performance comercial.
  • Experiência na criação e implementação de programas de incentivo e ativação comercial.
  • Capacidade analítica para acompanhamento de KPIs e identificação de oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Habilidade para conduzir negociações comerciais complexas e projetos estratégicos.
  • Forte capacidade de liderança, influência e desenvolvimento de times.
  • Perfil altamente energético e orientado para resultados.
  • Forte senso de dono e espírito empreendedor.
  • Visão estratégica combinada com excelência na execução.
  • Perfil proativo, resiliente e focado em crescimento.
  • Facilidade para construir relacionamentos e influenciar parceiros comerciais.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes e forte presença em campo.
  • Flexibilidade para atuar em diferentes segmentos dentro do canal foodservice.

About Kerry

A Kerry é a empresa líder mundial em soluções de sabor e nutrição para as indústrias de alimentos, bebidas e farmacêutica. Todos os dias, trabalhamos em parceria com nossos clientes para criar produtos mais saudáveis, saborosos e sustentáveis, consumidos por bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo. Nossa visão é ser o parceiro mais valorizado de nossos clientes, contribuindo para um mundo de nutrição sustentável. Construir uma carreira na Kerry significa ter a oportunidade de ajudar a moldar o futuro da alimentação, ao mesmo tempo em que desenvolve seu potencial em um ambiente verdadeiramente global e diverso.

O que a Kavak te proporciona:

A Kavak iniciou a revolução no mercado automotivo em 2016, criando uma plataforma baseada no uso de dados e tecnologia que compra, recondiciona e vende carros usados pela internet ou nas dependências da empresa (hubs), com todas as garantias de segurança e confiabilidade, além das melhores opções de financiamento. title: Keeta Senior Finance Operations Specialist
description:
Educational requirements: Bachelor's degree

Experience requirements: 10 years

Job responsibilities:

1. Business Support: Partner with Keeta Brazil business teams to assess the financial impact of business activities in accordance with local accounting standards (BR GAAP / IFRS) and compliance requirements. Design and deliver financial solutions to support business growth and commercial decision-making. 2. Local Accounting: Develop a deep understanding of Brazil's financial compliance framework. Ensure accurate and compliant bookkeeping of local financial transactions. 3. Finance Digitalization: Collaborate with product and engineering teams to drive finance informatization initiatives, including online billing and settlement, automated accounting entries, business-finance data reconciliation, and financial system upgrades. 4. Process Optimization: Lead process reviews to improve finance operations efficiency and accuracy. Identify workflow bottlenecks and redundancies. Actively explore and apply AI tools (LLM-assisted solution writing, automated reconciliation, anomaly detection, etc.) to enhance finance operational effectiveness. 5. Cross-functional Coordination: Collaborate closely with other finance teams to support business needs and other assigned tasks.

Job requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or above in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related fields; 8+ years of relevant finance/accounting experience; prior experience in accounting operations and financial system integration is preferred. 2. Background in a public accounting firm (Big 4 or reputable local firm, at least 4+ years) and/or finance roles at an internet/technology company (in-house). Candidates with both backgrounds are strongly preferred. 3. Familiarity with Brazilian accounting standards (BR GAAP / IFRS), local bookkeeping practices, Financial Software (e.g., Totvs, SAP) and Brazil's tax invoice system (NF-e, NFS-e, etc.) is a strong plus. 4. Strong communication and coordination skills; ability to work effectively with business stakeholders. Excellent analytical and logical thinking; detail-oriented, responsible, and a strong team player with a service mindset. 5. Able to use both English and Portuguese as daily working languages.6. Passionate about AI — enthusiastic and curious about how AI can reshape finance workflows.

Job highlights:

- Be part of Keeta's overseas business journey from day one — deeply involved in daily operations and finance system building (including AI initiatives), with full exposure to international finance at scale. - A rare and highly rewarding experience in global internet finance, with broad personal development opportunities.

title: Assistente Jurídico Previdenciário
description:

Atuamos com processos modernos, automações e inteligência artificial para transformar a forma como o trabalho jurídico é realizado.

Temos um ambiente dinâmico, acelerado e com bastante espaço para aprender na prática, assumir novas responsabilidades e crescer junto com a empresa. Fugimos do tradicionalismo dos escritórios e buscamos construir uma operação cada vez mais tecnológica, eficiente e próxima dos nossos clientes.

title: Commercial Financial BP
description:
At Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies , our 8,000+ global associates are proud to come to work each day, knowing that what we do impacts the lives of patients around the world.

We make medical devices and related products that are used to collect, separate, manufacture and process various components of blood and cells. With our innovative technologies and service offerings, we touch a patient’s life every second of every day and are committed to continuing to increase the number of patients we serve.

With some of the best and brightest minds in the industry, an unmatched global footprint, comprehensive benefits and a distinct culture, Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies is a great place to work, grow and be part of a team that is focused on making a difference. Consider joining our team and unlock your potential.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for a Commercial Finance Business Partner LATAM to support the commercial organization across the region and act as a key financial partner in business growth and decision-making.

This is a regional role with exposure to multiple LATAM markets, working closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Operations and other business stakeholders. The position will play a critical role in connecting financial strategy with commercial objectives, providing insights that support profitable and sustainable growth.

The ideal candidate will combine strong financial expertise with a genuine business mindset, the ability to challenge commercial decisions constructively, and the agility to operate in a dynamic, multicultural environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Partner with LATAM commercial leadership to analyze business performance and identify opportunities to improve sales, profitability and operating results.

• Prepare and evaluate business cases for customer transactions, new business opportunities and strategic initiatives, providing financial recommendations to support decision-making.

• Analyze sales, margins, profitability, pricing and operating expenses, identifying risks and opportunities and recommending proactive actions.

• Lead and coordinate budgeting, forecasting and strategic planning processes across LATAM, including variance analysis and management reporting.

• Develop financial models and projections for new business opportunities, customer solutions, investments and strategic projects.

• Support the commercial organization in evaluating customer deals, pricing strategies and profitability, challenging assumptions when necessary to ensure sustainable growth.

• Prepare weekly sales forecasts and monthly reports and dashboards to provide clear visibility into LATAM commercial performance.

• Partner with Sales, Marketing, Operations and Finance teams across different LATAM countries, acting as a bridge between regional and global finance organizations.

• Identify opportunities to improve internal processes, pricing competitiveness and financial efficiency across the region.

• Support Sales and commercial teams with financial tools, analysis and training to strengthen business decision-making.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Education

• University degree in Economics, Finance, Business Administration or a related field. Accounting background is a plus.

Experience

• 7+ years of relevant professional experience, ideally with 5–8 years in Commercial Finance, FP&A or Business Partnering roles.

• Experience working with commercial teams in a regional or multinational environment.

• Strong understanding of pricing, profitability, forecasting and financial modeling.

• Experience working across LATAM or other emerging markets is highly valued.

Technical Skills

• Advanced financial modeling and analytical capabilities.

• Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and P&L analysis.

• Experience with pricing and profitability analysis.

• Ability to translate financial and market data into actionable business recommendations.

• Advanced Excel skills and experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI.

• Experience with ERP and financial systems, preferably SAP.

Business & Leadership Skills

• Strong commercial mindset and understanding of business growth drivers.

• Ability to influence decisions and challenge commercial strategies through data and financial insights.

• Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to explain financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders across different countries and cultures.

Languages

• Advanced English is required.

• Spanish and/or Portuguese are highly valued for regional collaboration.

Location & Travel

The position will be based in one of Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies' LATAM locations, with a regional scope covering key markets across Latin America. Availability to travel within the region as required.

WHY JOIN TERUMO BLOOD AND CELL TECHNOLOGIES?

Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies is part of Terumo Group, founded in 1921 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

In 2024, Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies reached $1.5 billion in revenue.

We employ nearly 8,000 associates globally, with global headquarters in Lakewood, CO, U.S., and regional headquarters in Brussels, Buenos Aires, Singapore and Tokyo.

We manufacture devices, disposable sets and solutions at our facilities in Belgium, India, Japan, Northern Ireland, the U.S. and Vietnam. Our global presence enables us to serve customers in more than 130 countries.

Our core values help set our direction, guide our actions and keep us true to our corporate mission of contributing to society through healthcare.

  • Respect – Appreciative of others
  • Integrity – Guided by our mission
  • Care – Empathetic to patients
  • Quality – Committed to excellence
  • Creativity – Striving for innovation

title: Head of Project Control
description:
About us

Hanseatic Global Terminals (HGT) is a fully owned subsidiary of Hapag-Lloyd. Operating from Rotterdam, HGT manages a portfolio of stakes in 26 marine terminals and complementary logistics services across 13 countries across 5 continents: Europe, North America, South America, Asia, Africa - with plans to expand its stakes to ~30 terminals by 2030.

Spanning key regions, its portfolio comprises port terminals and related logistics services operated by Hanseatic Global Terminals Latin America in Latin America and Florida (USA), and, in the booming Indian market, it is present through the container terminals, depots and rail business of J M Baxi, India’s largest integrated terminal and logistics provider. Additionally, HGT’s presence in strategic European hubs, such as Germany, France and the Mediterranean, enhances its global network and allows it to offer seamless, efficient logistics and supply chain solutions to customers worldwide.

At HGT, we are a highly motivated team of experienced international professionals who believe that growth in any partnership comes from trust and dedication. Our commitment to provide highly efficient terminal operations that are safe, sustainable, and reliable is rooted in a simple yet powerful vision: “offering exceptional service quality at all times.”

The project: Hanseatic Global Terminals Aracruz port terminal:

Hanseatic Global Terminals (HGT) is embarking on an exciting new chapter with the development of Hanseatic Global Terminals Aracruz , a state‑of‑the‑art container terminal created in partnership with the Imetame Group. Following HGT’s recent agreement to acquire 50% of the shares in Imetame Logística Porto (ILP) , this joint venture marks a significant strategic investment in Brazil’s evolving port landscape and will play a key role in strengthening global supply chain connectivity.

Located in Aracruz, Espírito Santo, the new terminal is designed to be a modern transshipment and gateway hub for the region. Expected to launch operations by mid‑2028, the facility will feature a capacity of approximately 1.2 million TEU, 750 meters of quay, advanced cargo‑handling technology, and 17 meters of water depth, enabling the efficient handling of the industry’s largest vessels.

As HGT and the Imetame Group work together to build and operate this future‑ready terminal, we are assembling a team of talented professionals who will help shape the next major milestone in Brazil’s port infrastructure development. The project represents an opportunity to be part of a transformational venture that will set new standards for performance, innovation, and operational excellence.

The position

The Head of Project Control is responsible for creating a clear and trusted view of project performance by ensuring accurate, timely, and transparent communication across internal teams and external stakeholders. This role brings project management excellence to the forefront by applying best practices, and tools, to support strong decision making and maintain focus on customer value as it evolves. At the same time, the Head of Project Controls cultivates a proactive, insight-driven project environment by using leading and lagging indicators to anticipate risks early, highlight improvement opportunities, and guide the project consistently toward successful outcomes.

Success requires transparency, deep expertise, and a forward-looking mindset that continuously predicts, improves, and strengthens project performance.

Key Responsibilities

The Head of Project Controls is expected to perform the following responsibilities throughout the project:

General

  • Implement, maintain, and champion the transparent use of HGT project management and control tools across the project team, consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
  • Establish and maintain the project’s scope, schedule, quality, and budget baselines.
  • Facilitate:

-Effective application of core project governance processes, including (Change management, scope, schedule, requirements, and budget changes)

-Risk management, ensuring timely input and ownership from the project team

-Document Management and correspondence registration system

  • Monitor progress against approved baselines and ensure that deviations are identified early, addressed promptly, and escalated or reported when necessary
  • Ensure correct and timely project performance reporting:

-within the project and team.

-to Project Director and other relevant project leaders.

-to Head Office.

-to other corporate counterparts (as required).

Communication

  • Function as primary point of contact for all project control systems and be responsible for the user rights administration.
  • Liaise with the functional counterpart on project control system issues and improvements.
  • Hold regular touchpoints with construction, equipment, IT and finance teams to stay ahead of potential project control issues.
  • Build and sustain strong working relationships with head office counterparts, consultants, contractors, and suppliers.

Interfaces

  • Work closely with all project disciplines to ensure consistent, accurate, and coordinated project controls.
  • Liaise with relevant HGT global departments to maintain alignment with company standards and best practices.

Job requirements

  • Relevant professional experience: 10 years overall, including a minimum of 5 years within a project controls functional discipline.
  • Holding a bachelor’s degree (or relevant).
  • Working in a cultural and technical diverse team and environment, internally and externally to your organization.
  • Confidently present and communicate with internal project teams and external HQ stakeholders in both written and spoken English and Portuguese.
  • Coach, mentor, and support others across the project team or wider functional areas.
  • Demonstrate relevant, practical technical experience and knowledge in project controls and project management disciplines.
  • Delivering a high-level of accuracy and quality.
  • Hold an advanced project management qualification, such as APM PMQ, PMI PMP, or an equivalent certification.
  • Proficient in project management platforms and systems used for document control, contract management, change control, cost management, communications, and milestone tracking (e.g., Aconex, PMWeb, PCM, Skire, or similar).
  • Skilled in project management and scheduling tools such as Primavera Cloud, Primavera P6, MS Project, or equivalent.
  • Experience supervising or line-managing others in project controls or project management roles.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to shape the global footprint of a fast-growing terminal operator.
  • High-impact leadership role in a dynamic, global, and collaborative organization.

title: Crypto Operations Specialist
description:
About us

Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.

About the role

Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.

What you will do

  • Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts.
  • Work with non-custodial wallets (MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum.
  • Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets.
  • Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out.
  • Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed.
  • Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team.
  • Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage.
  • Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem.
  • Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here.
  • Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.

What we are looking for

  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side.
  • Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong.
  • Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits.
  • Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals.
  • Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit.
  • Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did.
  • Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support.
  • Stable internet connection and your own computer.

Nice to have

  • Experience with DeFi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar.
  • Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange.
  • Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.

What the role offers

  • Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year
  • Paid vacation
  • Full medical insurance
  • Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered
  • Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company
  • Budget for professional courses and certifications
  • Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

title: Analista de contabilidade
description:
JOIN THE TASTE.

Na Dr. Oetker, pensamos à frente há mais de 130 anos. Além de criar produtos que fazem parte da vida de milhões de famílias, também construímos uma área Financeira orientada a dados, excelência operacional, governança e conformidade, preparada para o futuro.

Seu Papel

Nesta posição, você terá um papel fundamental no fortalecimento da governança financeira e no suporte à tomada de decisão em toda a organização. Combinando expertise técnica, pensamento analítico e colaboração multidisciplinar, você garantirá precisão, transparência e melhoria contínua nos processos financeiros e nas iniciativas estratégicas do negócio.

Seu Impacto

Você atuará como um parceiro estratégico das áreas internas, traduzindo dados financeiros em insights claros, apoiando a revisão de processos e contribuindo ativamente para decisões operacionais e estratégicas. Ao colaborar com diferentes áreas, você trará clareza, agilidade e consistência às rotinas financeiras e aos projetos corporativos.

O Que Você Fará

Parceria Estratégica com o Negócio

  • Atuar como ponto de apoio e referência para as áreas internas, fornecendo análises e informações financeiras que orientem decisões essenciais.
  • Apoiar a liderança na revisão de processos, identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e otimização de rotinas contábeis e fiscais.
  • Oferecer informações consistentes e tempestivas para públicos internos e externos, incluindo auditorias, garantindo comunicação transparente e assertiva.

Projetos & Melhoria Contínua

  • Contribuir para iniciativas de melhoria contínua, trazendo visão crítica e propondo soluções que elevem eficiência, governança e compliance.
  • Colaborar em projetos internos, assegurando alinhamento entre requisitos financeiros, prazos e entregas.
  • Participar de esforços interdisciplinares para fortalecer controles, reduzir ineficiências e modernizar processos financeiros e operacionais.

Rotinas Financeiras Operacionais

  • Executar rotinas de fechamento mensal, incluindo conciliações contábeis e elaboração de relatórios.
  • Auxiliar na preparação das demonstrações financeiras conforme normas vigentes.
  • Preparar o Imposto de Renda – regime de Lucro Real.

title: Geoscience Data Manager Specialist
description:
Position Summary

Bluware, a wholly owned subsidiary of CMG (Computer Modelling Group) in Brazil is seeking a Geoscience Data Manager Specialist to support Petrobras by preparing seismic datasets for use with InteractivAI. The primary responsibility of this role is converting seismic data from SEG-Y to VDS using Bluware software, ensuring that datasets are correctly configured and available for interpretation workflows.

The specialist will also provide first-level assistance related to data preparation and basic OSDU interactions, working closely with Petrobras and Bluware’s technical teams when required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Convert seismic datasets from SEG-Y to VDS using Bluware software.
  • Validate seismic datasets prior to conversion, including verification of geometry, headers, metadata, and coordinate reference information.
  • Verify the quality and completeness of converted VDS datasets.
  • Provide first-level support for issues related to seismic data conversion.
  • Support users with basic OSDU data access and dataset availability questions as they relate to InteractivAI workflows.
  • Escalate software defects or complex technical issues to Bluware’s technical support and engineering teams.
  • Follow established procedures and best practices for data conversion.
  • Collaborate with Petrobras and Bluware personnel to ensure timely delivery of converted datasets.

Note: This description reflects the general nature of the role. It’s not a complete list of responsibilities—we believe in flexibility, initiative, and growing together.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geophysics, Geology, or related Geoscience discipline.
  • Basic understanding of seismic data and SEG-Y format.
  • Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to follow standardized operational procedures.
  • Basic computer skills in Windows.
  • Good communication skills in Portuguese.
  • Basic English reading skills for technical documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience with seismic data loading or management.
  • Familiarity with VDS or other seismic data formats.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data environments.
  • Basic Python knowledge is a plus.

Key Skills

  • SEG-Y data handling
  • Seismic data quality control
  • Data conversion workflows
  • Communication
  • Teamwork
  • Problem solving
  • Time management

Scope of Support

The role focuses on:

  • Preparing seismic datasets for InteractivAI.
  • Executing SEG-Y to VDS conversions.
  • Performing basic validation of converted data.
  • Providing first-level operational support for conversion-related questions.
  • Assisting users with basic OSDU-related questions that impact data availability for InteractivAI.

Confira a vaga e venha fazer parte do nosso time!

  • Gerir o portfólio de projetos estratégicos como PMO executivo: governança, priorização, riscos, cronogramas e visibilidade para a alta liderança.
  • Liderar projetos estratégicos de ponta a ponta no modelo de consultoria interna — diagnóstico, desenho da solução, implementação e mensuração de ganhos.
  • Atuar hands-on em iniciativas de supply chain (S&OP, demanda, PCP, estoques, logística), melhoria de processos e eficiência operacional.
  • Acompanhar KPIs e metas corporativas, identificar gaps e apoiar as áreas na construção e execução de planos de ação.
  • Conduzir a gestão de mudança e o engajamento de stakeholders, influenciando as áreas sem depender de autoridade formal.
  • Desenvolver e liderar a equipe de consultores internos e analistas de projetos.

O que buscamos:

  • Sólida experiência na área, com trajetória robusta em consultorias de implementação, operações, transformação ou excelência operacional.
  • Experiência em implementação de projetos estratégicos, com participação direta na execução e na captura de resultados.
  • Forte experiência em supply chain, operações e melhoria de processos.
  • Vivência em gestão de portfólio, governança executiva e desdobramento de metas (KPIs/OKRs).
  • Capacidade de construir business cases, análises e apresentações executivas para a alta liderança.
  • Experiência em gestão de stakeholders seniores (Diretoria, Presidência ou Conselho).
  • Domínio de Lean/Six Sigma, Power BI, Excel e PowerPoint executivo e ferramentas de gestão de projetos.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens recorrentes ao interior de MG e ES.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em bens de consumo, automotivo, varejo de móveis e/ou eletrodomésticos.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em gestão, operações, supply chain, finanças ou estratégia.
  • Inglês avançado e conhecimento em analytics avançado, data science ou automação aplicada a operações.

Se inscreva e venha fazer parte do time Itatiaia!

title: ANALISTA DE FINOPS PL, REMOTO.
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Visibilidade e Alocação de Custos:

Forecasting e Planejamento:

  • Elaborar previsões de gastos (forecasting) e apoiar o ciclo de planejamento orçamentário.

title: Head of Business & Operations (Brazil Resident)
description:
About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.

Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Business & Operations Officer on the ground. Under BCB Resolution 520/2025, VASPs are required to designate a statutory director responsible for conducting the institution's business and ensuring alignment with its commercial and strategic objectives — this is that seat. In your first year, you will have established the operational foundation of Gate's Brazil entity, built the company's commercial presence in the market, and ensured our business activities run in full alignment with the BCB's regulatory expectations.

What you'll do

  • Hold statutory director responsibility for business conduct and operations at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Oversee and conduct the institution's day-to-day business activities, ensuring alignment with Gate's commercial strategy and operational objectives in Brazil
  • Act as the primary operational interface between Gate's Brazil entity and its regional and global leadership, translating strategic direction into local execution
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the business and operations workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline
  • Discharge any additional duties prescribed by applicable Brazilian laws, regulations, or by the company

What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship , with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing statutory director or officer seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • A predominantly commercial and operational profile — you have led or co-led a business unit, market expansion, or operational function, not just supported one
  • Prior experience at a BCB-regulated financial institution, fintech, or crypto/VASP — familiarity with how regulated entities operate in Brazil is essential
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires

Nice-to-have

  • Prior experience in the crypto or digital asset industry
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB on regulatory filings, inspections, or authorisation processes
  • Academic background or postgraduate training in business, finance, economics, or law

title: Analista de Inteligência Estratégica Antifraude
description:
Estamos em busca de um Analista de Inteligência Estratégia Antifraude com experiência em:

  • Perfilamento e Análise Comportamental : Categorização analítica de clientes (PF/PJ) e mapeamento de padrões (_baselines_) para detectar desvios e identificar contas vulneráveis.
  • Engenharia e Otimização de Regras : Criação, calibração e limpeza contínua do livro de regras, para maximizar o bloqueio de fraudes e mitigar a taxa de falsos positivos.
  • Simulação e Backtesting: Execução de testes em massas de dados históricos e testes, para prever o impacto financeiro e operacional antes do _go-live_.
  • Estudos Estatísticos e Causa-Raiz : Investigação pós-mortem de ataques, testes de hipóteses e criação de novas variáveis analíticas (_feature engineering_).
  • Gestão de KPIs e RO I: Acompanhamento contínuo da taxa de perda (_Loss Rate_), _Hit Rate_, taxa de captura e demonstração do retorno financeiro das estratégias.

Conhecimento e Qualificação :

Manipulação de Dados (SQL Avançado): Domínio na extração, agregação pesada e cruzamento de dados em ambientes de Big Data (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL).

Programação Analítica (Python/R) : Fluência no uso de bibliotecas estatísticas para análise exploratória, limpeza e manipulação avançada de grandes volumes de dados.

Estatística Aplicada e Machine Learning : Aplicação de estatística inferencial, avaliação de métricas de modelos (Curva ROC-AUC, Precision, Recall) e parceria com _Data Science_.

Motores de Risco e Visualização de Dados : Experiência técnica na lógica de motores antifraude e construção de dashboards executivos (Power BI, Looker, Tableau).

Diferencial

Domínio do Negócio e Meios de Pagamento: Entendimento profundo das jornadas transacionais (Pix, Cartão, Boletos), vetores de ataque (_ATO_, golpes, contas laranjas).

The role also involves conducting awareness sessions and drafting reports, policies, and procedures that are clear, practical, and aligned with applicable regulatory frameworks.

  • Candidates should possess effective communication skills, including the capacity to prepare clear documentation, deliver training sessions, and engage with diverse stakeholders.
  • Candidates should possess strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Relevant experience in compliance, audit, or advisory roles within finance, accounting, or fintech environments is beneficial.
  • A bachelor’s degree in law, finance, accounting, information systems, or a related field is preferred; professional certifications in compliance, risk management, or data protection are a plus.
  • Familiarity with regional and international regulatory bodies, cross-border data transfer rules, and industry best practices in governance and ethics is advantageous.

Global Market Mapping & Talent Intelligence

Proactive Sourcing & Candidate Identification

Candidate Experience & Process Excellence

Employer Brand & External Presence

  • Represent the organization positively when interacting with external talent.
  • Share the employer value proposition clearly and consistently.
  • Contribute to targeted outreach campaigns and engagement initiatives.

Tools, Technology & Data Discipline

  • Maintain accurate candidate and pipeline data within recruiting tools.
  • Use sourcing platforms and talent intelligence tools with increasing proficiency.
  • Support basic reporting and pipeline updates for Talent Partners.

Candidate Profile

Experience & Capability

  • Previous experience in recruitment, sourcing, HR, or related areas.
  • Previous experience in recruitment for US companies or Global market - desirable
  • Previous experience in recruitment in LATAM region - desirable
  • Exposure to research, sourcing, or candidate engagement preferred.

Technical Strength

Mindset & Behaviours

title: Comprador Pleno
description:
Na Newell Brands, temos orgulho de ser uma empresa líder global em bens de consumo, com mais de 50 marcas icônicas que podem ser encontradas em lares ao redor do mundo, incluindo Oster®, Cadence®, NUK®, Lillo®, Invicta®, Contigo®, Coleman®, Rubbermaid®, PaperMate®, Sharpie®, Graco® entre outras.

Todas as candidaturas são bem-vindas, independentemente de identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, religião, idade ou deficiência. Como Comprador Pleno , você será responsável por gerenciar categorias de compras, definir estratégias de sourcing e conduzir negociações com fornecedores. Atuará na gestão contratual e no acompanhamento de indicadores, identificando oportunidades de redução de custos. Trabalhará de forma integrada com áreas internas, garantindo eficiência e compliance na cadeia de suprimentos.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e acompanhar indicadores de performance (savings, lead time, nível de serviço, ruptura), utilizando dashboards e ferramentas de BI
  • Realizar modelagem e breakdown de custos para identificação de oportunidades de redução e ganho de eficiência
  • Avaliar e desenvolver fornecedores estratégicos, implementando programas de melhoria contínua e mitigando riscos operacionais, financeiros e reputacionais na cadeia de suprimentos

  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel, ferramentas de BI e sistemas ERP

Newell Brands (NASDAQ: NWL) is a leading global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well-known brands, including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Rubbermaid Commercial Products, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, FoodSaver, Dymo, EXPO, Elmer’s, Oster, NUK, Spontex and Campingaz. We are focused on delighting consumers by lighting up everyday moments.

title: GERENTE COMERCIAL REGIONAL
description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 14 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 3 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.

⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO

Garantir que a curva de comercialização e o business plan dos greenfields serão alcançados, envolvendo toda a equipe de consultores comerciais e negociando com lojistas das marcas que não são clientes corporativos. Garantir a comercialização de lojas efetivas (espaços novos e reposições) nos atuais SC´s do Grupo, com objetivo de minimizar áreas vagas e maximizar receitas de locação (leasing spread), garantir o allowance planejado, assim como a revenda de pontos orçada, além do planejamento da estratégia de negociação sobre novas lojas em todas as atuais unidades de negócios, viabilizando as diretrizes definidas no Planejamento Anual Comercial.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

Novos Empreendimentos do Grupo

Responsável pelo planejamento e lançamento dos novos negócios do grupo Iguatemi/expansões.

Negociar com as marcas “core” de cada projeto.

Responsável pelo comitê comercial, onde são apresentadas as propostas dos lojistas.

Responsável por implementar o shopping, coordenando as obras de todos os lojistas a fim de garantir 100% das lojas abertas na inauguração.

Interface direto com jurídico, mix e engenharia/arquitetura.

PAC (Planejamento Anual Comercial Iguatemi Leasing)

Liderar o processo de elaboração das estratégias dos PAC (Iguatemi Leasing) junto as demais áreas da empresa e garantir a completa execução das diretrizes planejadas tendo como principal objetivo analisar o desempenho de cada SC do grupo, identificando e acelerando oportunidades de melhorias de resultado de lojistas sempre com a preocupação de garantir a qualidade das marcas. O PAC é o foco da área comercial ao longo do ano.

Definir as premissas dos principais indicadores comerciais para o próximo ano como revenda de ponto (copart), leasing spread, allowance, capex para obras e a premissa de áreas vagas.

Controle de áreas vagas e negociações comerciais

Acompanhar a composição e variação do mix das diversas unidades de negócios, de acordo com o PAC, propondo ações, mudanças e negociações com novos lojistas (espaços novos e reposições), que visem à maximização dos resultados para o acionista mediante diretrizes definidas no Planejamento Anual Comercial.

Analisar em conjunto com a área de Mix o quadro de lojas de cada unidade versus o PAC, a fim de adequar a oferta do empreendimento às exigências dos consumidores.

Controlar número de vacância nos SC’s, acompanhando atividades de comercialização de lojas, com o objetivo de minimizar áreas vagas, mediante estabelecimento de metas e acompanhamento constante de resultados.

Propostas

Analisar todas as propostas comerciais, visando garantir ganhos de leasing spread (Ganho Real de Receita do novo contrato x anterior), maximizando receitas de locação nos SC’s do Grupo, através de rigoroso controle para obtenção dos objetivos.

Consolidação dos resultados

Acompanhar a consolidação dos estudos de Copart (Luvas Comerciais), Leasing Spread (Ganho Real de Receita do novo contrato x anterior), Allowance, Capex, Vacância dos SC’s do Grupo, visando garantir os melhores resultados para a companhia.

Performance de Lojistas

Avaliar a performance (acompanhamento das vendas, custo de ocupação, duração de contrato, ações de marketing) resultando em ações efetivas para melhoria de desempenho das lojas existentes nos empreendimentos e coordenar estudos sobre a locação de novos lojistas com a validação da área de mix mediante discussões de resultados das lojas.

Acompanhar junto com os Gerentes Gerais a performance dos lojistas, visando garantir a melhor rentabilidade para o shopping.

OBSERVAÇÕES

Pós Graduação/MBA em Administração, Economia, Marketing ou áreas afins.

title: Pessoa Encarregada de Limpeza
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Office Management Manager-Brazil(A114797)
description:
Position Overview

As a comprehensive workplace manager, you will be responsible for establishing the administrative system for large‑scale integrated workplaces, leading team management, and conducting in‑depth alignment with corporate headquarters administration.

Application Scope

This role applies to large‑scale integrated workplaces (headcount ≥ 50) or regional administrative lead positions. Incumbents are expected to undertake team management, budget decision‑making and strategic planning responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

1.1 Workplace Operation Strategy & Management

1）Formulate regional workplace operation strategies, drive continuous improvement of office environment and employee experience upgrade.

2）Build regional 5S management system and develop reusable management standards.

3）Plan annual activity calendar and oversee delivery of regional cultural events.

4）Establish reception service standards and coordinate cross‑regional high‑profile receptions.

5）Take overall charge of regional EHS compliance management and develop emergency response frameworks.

1.2 Expense & Budget Oversight

1）Lead preparation and review of regional administrative budgets, and take accountability for regional budget outcomes.

2）Approve regional expense disbursements, monitor compliance risks and identify cost‑saving & efficiency‑improvement opportunities.

3）Collaborate with headquarters to deliver regional cost optimization and maintain healthy overall expense performance.

4）Oversee payments to regional vendors, control payment schedules and leverage payment terms to optimize cash flow.

1.3 Asset Management Oversight

1）Establish regional asset management policy framework to guarantee consistency between asset records and physical inventory.

2）Approve major vehicle procurement and disposal proposals, and optimize allocation of regional vehicle resources.

3）Align with headquarters asset policies, and supervise regional asset inventory and disposal activities.

1.4 Vendor Management

1）Participate in headquarters‑level vendor framework negotiations to optimize regional supply chain.

2）Manage relationships with key regional vendors and drive continuous service improvement.

3）Develop regional vendor tier‑based management system to iteratively optimize supply‑chain structure.

4）Review and approve proposals for regional vendor onboarding and offboarding.

1.5 Regional Workplace Construction & Standardization

1）Develop strategies for launching new country‑level workplaces, align with headquarters resources to ensure standardized implementation.

2）Contribute to headquarters administrative standard formulation, and supervise regional training and compliance execution.

3）Facilitate experience sharing and methodology accumulation across regional workplaces.

1.6 Visa & Expat Assignment Support

1）Build regional support framework for expatriate employees, coordinate resources to guarantee smooth on‑landing for assignees.

2）Collaborate with headquarters Administration and HR teams to continuously enhance regional expatriate support solutions.

1.7 Onboarding & Offboarding Administrative Support

1）Establish standardized SOPs for regional employee onboarding and offboarding administrative support to deliver seamless employee experience and efficient handover.

1.8 Digital‑enabled Administrative Service

1）Lead promotion and operation of regional administrative service platforms to advance digitalization of local administrative services.

2）Consolidate regional system requirements and partner with headquarters Administration to iterate platform functionalities.

1.9 Communication & IT Infrastructure Support

1）Develop regional communication and IT infrastructure operation strategies to ensure stable connectivity of office networks and communication facilities.

2）Participate in formulation and optimization of regional IT support solutions.

1.10 Team Management

3）Directly manage administrative teams including Supervisors and Specialists, covering recruitment & selection, performance management and talent development.

4）Drive cross‑department collaboration within the region, represent the administrative function in business decision‑making and major project governance.

5）Maintain close alignment with headquarters Administration, and contribute to headquarters administrative decision‑making and system building.

6）Set up regional administrative talent pipeline development mechanisms.

Education & Professional Experience

1. Bachelor’s degree or above, major in Administration Management, Business Administration, Human Resources or related disciplines is preferred.

2. 5‑8 years or above working experience in administration, operation or relevant fields, with minimum 2 years of people‑management experience.

3. Prior experience in multinational enterprises or cross‑cultural management is a plus.

Core Competencies

1. Strategic Thinking: Systematic mindset, capable of contributing to headquarters standard‑setting and providing professional judgment for regional matters.

2. Business Acumen: Take ownership of regional administrative budget performance; proactively identify cost‑reduction and efficiency‑gain opportunities.

3. Organizational Influence: Direct‑line team management capability, with proven track record in talent selection, development and performance management.

4. Cross‑cultural Communication: Deliver effective communication across cultures and hierarchy levels, and manage complex stakeholder relationships.

5. Risk Anticipation: Foresee potential risks, formulate contingency plans and resolve regional issues in a systematic manner.

Language & Qualifications

1. Fluent in English and local language for high‑level business communication and negotiation.

2. Possess a valid local driving license.

Next steps:

title: Financial Assistant
description:
Finance Compliance Specialist

Location: Cidade Monções, São Paulo, Brazil

Work Arrangement: Five days onsite

Travel Requirement: No regular travel required

Work Schedule: Subject to local labor laws and regulations; the role requires frequent collaboration across Brazil–China time zones

Overtime Requirement: Subject to local labor laws and regulations

Role Overview

We are looking for a Finance Compliance Specialist based in São Paulo, Brazil. This role will support financial compliance, accounting, tax reporting, audit coordination, regulatory data reporting, and account reconciliation activities across Brazil, Mexico, the United States, and other key Latin American markets.

The ideal candidate will have 3–8 years of professional experience in finance, accounting, audit, tax, or compliance. The candidate must be fluent in both Portuguese and English and comfortable working closely with stakeholders in Brazil, mainland China, and Hong Kong across different time zones.

Experience as an auditor, or substantial experience coordinating with internal or external auditors, is required. Knowledge of Brazilian taxation, including differences in tax requirements across Brazilian states, will be considered a strong advantage.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and support compliance with financial regulations, tax laws, statutory requirements, and reporting obligations across Brazil, the United States, Mexico, and other key Latin American jurisdictions.
  • Participate in corporate compliance activities, including external regulatory filings, statutory data submissions, financial data reporting, and other compliance-related declarations.
  • Prepare, review, and coordinate the filing of statutory financial statements, tax returns, regulatory reports, and other required submissions in accordance with applicable local laws.
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, responding to audit inquiries, providing explanations, and coordinating with relevant internal stakeholders.
  • Liaise with external auditors, tax advisers, tax authorities, legal counsel, and other external service providers regarding audits, compliance matters, and regulatory inquiries.
  • Monitor changes in financial, accounting, tax, and compliance regulations and assess their potential impact on company operations.
  • Collaborate with regional and global finance teams to implement and improve finance compliance policies, internal controls, and operating procedures.
  • Identify financial and compliance risks and recommend corrective or preventive actions.
  • Maintain accurate and complete records of compliance activities, regulatory submissions, audit documentation, and supporting materials.
  • Conduct detailed reconciliations of key accounts, investigate discrepancies, and ensure issues are resolved in a timely manner.
  • Provide support for tax-related matters, where required, including research and coordination regarding Brazilian federal, state, and municipal tax requirements.
  • Work closely with local Portuguese-speaking stakeholders and communicate in English with teams and stakeholders in mainland China and Hong Kong.
  • Participate in meetings and complete business-critical tasks across Brazil–China time zones when necessary.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Taxation, or a related field.
  • 3–8 years of relevant professional experience in financial compliance, accounting, audit, tax, or a related finance function.

title: Product Owner (PO)
description:
Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos um(a) Product Owner para liderar a implementação da Reforma Tributária em nossos sistemas. O profissional será responsável por traduzir as exigências fiscais e as Normas Técnicas publicadas pelos órgãos reguladores em requisitos claros e acionáveis para os times de desenvolvimento, garantindo que nossas soluções estejam em conformidade com a nova legislação dentro dos prazos definidos pelo cronograma de transição.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como ponte entre a área fiscal/tributária e os times técnicos, traduzindo Normas Técnicas, notas técnicas e legislações (IBS, CBS, Split Payment, entre outras) em requisitos de produto e histórias de usuário.
  • Priorizar e gerenciar o backlog de implementação da Reforma Tributária, equilibrando prazos regulatórios, complexidade técnica e impacto no negócio.
  • Acompanhar as publicações de Notas Técnicas, layouts e atualizações de schemas (NF-e, NFC-e, CT-e, entre outros documentos fiscais) e avaliar seus impactos nos sistemas.
  • Definir critérios de aceite e validar entregas junto aos times de desenvolvimento e QA.
  • Interagir com stakeholders internos (fiscal, jurídico, contabilidade, TI) e, quando necessário, externos (consultorias tributárias, fornecedores de ERP/ferramentas fiscais).
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (refinamento, planning, review) relacionadas à frente de reforma tributária.
  • Monitorar o cronograma de transição da Reforma Tributária (fases de teste, coexistência e vigência plena) e garantir que as entregas estejam alinhadas aos marcos legais.
  • Produzir documentação clara sobre as mudanças implementadas, para times internos e áreas de negócio.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia como Product Owner, Analista de Negócios ou função correlata, preferencialmente em produtos/sistemas fiscais ou tributários.
  • Conhecimento fiscal sólido , com familiaridade em tributos sobre consumo (ICMS, PIS/COFINS, ISS) e, idealmente, nos fundamentos da Reforma Tributária (IBS, CBS, Imposto Seletivo).
  • Capacidade comprovada de leitura e interpretação de Normas Técnicas, legislações e documentação regulatória, traduzindo-as em requisitos técnicos.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e ferramentas de gestão de backlog (Jira, Azure DevOps ou similares).
  • Boa comunicação, com facilidade para dialogar tanto com áreas fiscais/jurídicas quanto com times técnicos.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e proativo na antecipação de riscos regulatórios.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em projetos de adequação a mudanças fiscais anteriores (ex.: implantação de NF-e, e-Social, EFD-Reinf).
  • Conhecimento em sistemas ERP e módulos fiscais.
  • Formação ou pós-graduação em Direito Tributário, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
  • Certificação em Product Ownership (PSPO, CSPO ou similar).

Modalidade: 100% remoto

Modalidade de Contrato: PJ

  • Analisar e gerenciar os formulários de controles de mudanças com o objetivo de manter sob controle as alterações que podem influenciar o processo ou a qualidade do produto.
  • Fornecer documentação para suporte a área regulatória a fim de atender os requisitos das agências reguladoras nacionais e internacionais.
  • Acompanhar inspeções e auditorias internas e externas embasados em documentos técnicos e legais vigentes da empresa e órgãos competentes relacionados, à fim de atender ao cumprimentos das Boas Práticas de Fabricação e legislações.

  • Ministrar treinamentos relacionados a Boas Práticas de Fabricação.
  • Auxiliar e orientar as atividades técnicas executadas pelo departamento da Garantia da Qualidade na ausência da supervisão, a fim de dar suporte à equipe.

title: Lean Management Manager-Warehouse Layout
description:
Location: GLP Guarulhos II - R. Concretex, 800 - Cumbica, Guarulhos - SP,

ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE

Key Responsibilities

1.Warehouse Layout Planning: Design warehouse layouts for new facilities and redesign existing layouts for renovation projects. Optimize picking, packing and shipping areas to reduce travel time, improve ergonomics and maximize space utilization.

2.Material Flow Optimization: Analyze inbound, put-away, picking and outbound processes; optimize material flow and work areas to increase efficiency.

3.Time Studies: Conduct detailed time studies and work sampling to establish and maintain standard operating times.

4.Capacity & ROI Analysis: Develop cost–benefit and ROI models for layout changes, automation investments and process improvements.

5.New Project Support: Provide IE support for new warehouse start-ups, process changes and layout integrations.

6.Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with operations, safety, IT and automation teams to ensure smooth implementation of changes.

Requirements

1.Bachelor’s degree or above in Industrial Engineering, Logistics Engineering, Operations Management or related fields.

2.3+ years of experience in warehouse IE, layout design or process improvement.

3.Familiarity with IE tools such as time studies, motion studies and capacity balancing.

4.Proficient in AutoCAD/Visio for layout design and Excel/Power BI for data analysis and reporting.

5.Strong numerical analysis and ROI modeling skills.

6.Excellent cross-department communication and coordination skills.

7.Good command of spoken and written English.

CAREERS AT SHEIN

We Commit to Inclusion

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

We Empower Talents with Diverse Careers

At SHEIN, we empower talent to excel with regular opportunities to elevate their career in their respective fields. As a dynamic business, we support internal mobility, diverse career pathways and recognition of success and contribution in a variety of meaningful ways.

We Engage with Global Cultures

SHEIN has over 20 offices worldwide , providing talent with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues around the world. Perspective sharing and leveraging cultural differences, is one of our core strenghts as we work on many exciting projects and draw insights from industry-leading experience.

title: [Produto] Product Designer Pleno
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Atuar no Chapter de Design & UX, na estrutura de Jornada do Cliente, sendo responsável pela frente de Product Design em squads de produtos, trabalhando em conjunto com PO e TL na evolução de produtos e sistemas utilizados por clientes internos e externos da TOTVS.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Atuar de ponta a ponta no processo de design (discovery, pesquisas, ideação, prototipação, validação, acompanhamento de entrega e métricas);
  • Trabalhar em parceria com PO, TL e stakeholders internos para compreender necessidades, mapear jornadas e transformar processos complexos em soluções simples, intuitivas e eficientes;
  • Propor novas funcionalidades e soluções para os clientes internos e externos da TOTVS, observando premissas e boas práticas de Usabilidade e Acessibilidade;
  • Identificar problemas de usabilidade, criar hipóteses e realizar testes para solucionar esses problemas de forma que realmente atenda as necessidades dos usuários;
  • Mapear jornadas as-is e propor jornadas to-be;
  • Liderar a criação de protótipos de baixa, média (navegável) e alta fidelidade;
  • Facilitar a colaboração com Designers, DEVs, Agilistas, PO, PM e outras Squads de Produto para traduzir os requisitos de negócio em experiências de uso e resultados;
  • Promover a comunicação e alinhamento entre as diversas squads de produtos para garantir uma experiência consistente para os clientes;
  • Apoiar na mensuração de impacto das soluções e propor evoluções contínuas;
  • Monitorar e analisar o uso dos produtos, a satisfação dos clientes, e acompanhar indicadores de sucesso para fomentar decisões orientadas a dados;
  • Acompanhar outros designers para garantir e promover o alto padrão de trabalho de UX/UI.

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Formação: Superior Completo (design, comunicação, tecnologia ou outras);
  • Experiência como Product Designer em empresas de TI com foco em desenvolvimento de produtos digitais;
  • Capacidade de navegar em cenários complexos, traduzindo regras de negócio em fluxos claros e funcionais;
  • Domínio em Figma e FigJam;
  • Conhecimento em métodos de pesquisa qualitativa e quantitativa;
  • Experiência com squads ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em Design System e criação de componentes;
  • Domínio sobre matriz CSD, roteiro de entrevistas, workshop de ideação, arquitetura de informação, wireframe, protótipo navegável, validações, teste de usabilidade;
  • Experiência com Design Sprint;
  • Conhecimento em IA para aumento de produtividade (Figma Make, NotebookLM, Gemini)

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

title: Senior Revenue Accountant - US GAAP & Process Automation
description:
Accounting Data Analyst — Revenue

As one of the top mobility companies in the world, we have been redefining the industry with innovative mobile technologies since 2013, driving us toward becoming a super app. Join us in our mission to combat global injustice.

We are looking for an experienced accounting professional with strong technical and data skills to join our global Accounting team. In this role, you'll prepare journal entries, account reconciliations, and revenue data packages that keep our books accurate, auditable, and US GAAP compliant — while writing the SQL and building the automation that makes those processes scalable as we prepare for public company readiness.

You'll report to a US-based Revenue Accounting leader (Eastern Time) and partner daily with accounting, data, and payment reconciliation colleagues across the globe. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable posting a journal entry in an ERP and querying a data warehouse — and who gets energized by fixing broken processes, not just running them.

What You'll Do

  • Prepare complete, review-ready journal entries across revenue, accounts receivable, payment provider settlements, chargebacks/refunds, taxes, and intercompany — with full supporting detail for ERP posting
  • Prepare account reconciliations, flux analyses, and supporting schedules for monthly, quarterly, and annual close
  • Write and maintain SQL queries against our data warehouse to extract and validate the data behind accruals and ASC 606 revenue recognition
  • Support payment service provider (PSP) reconciliations — validating settlement, refund, chargeback, and fee data across geographies and currencies, and flagging discrepancies
  • Document processes end-to-end and support SOX readiness, responding to internal and external audit requests as the preparer with full traceability from source to output
  • Identify manual, error-prone steps and automate them — including with AI-enabled tooling — partnering with Data Engineering, IT, and FinTech teams

What We're Looking For

  • ~8 years of progressive accounting experience, including hands-on journal entry preparation and month-end close ownership
  • Accounting degree with CRC or equivalent professional qualification (CPA-equivalent)
  • Solid working knowledge of US GAAP; hands-on ASC 606 revenue recognition experience is a major plus
  • Strong SQL skills — able to write and adapt queries against large-scale data warehouses (BigQuery or similar)
  • Proficiency with an ERP system (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle or similar): chart of accounts, journal entry posting, validation, and drill-down analysis
  • Experience supporting internal or external audits; exposure to SOX controls and documentation
  • Fluent English — this role works daily with a US-based team during Eastern Time hours

Nice to Have

  • Big 4 or large multinational (Fortune 500-scale) background; IPO or public company readiness experience
  • Industry experience with complex, high-volume revenue models (tech/marketplace, retail, media, manufacturing)
  • Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) and scripting for automation

Who Thrives Here

Someone gritty and curious who gets into the weeds, asks questions, and comes with proposed solutions. We're moving fast toward a bigger goal: priorities pivot, hours can stretch during peak periods, and feedback is direct. If you like ambiguity, ownership, and building processes that didn't exist yesterday, you'll fit right in!

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Comprehensive medical insurance coverage.
  • Meal allowance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Hybrid setting
  • Opportunity for advancement and upward mobility within the organization, allowing for increased levels of responsibility and growth within the company

title: Online Business English Teacher
description:
About the job

Company Description C-Leader English Academy helps professionals and executives develop the business English they need to perform in real-world corporate situations. The academy offers highly personalized programs tailored to each learner’s professional context, goals, and communication challenges, avoiding generic classes and focusing on efficiency. Its method combines realistic business scenarios, strategic communication practice, and direct application to daily work routines. This approach builds confidence, clarity, and measurable impact in the workplace. C-Leader is ideal for those seeking structured, purposeful, and fast-paced language development that supports leadership and global positioning.

Role Description

The Online Business English Teacher will deliver high-quality business-focused English lessons to professionals and executives, using C-Leader’s personalized methodology. Day-to-day tasks include preparing tailored lesson plans based on learners’ industries and roles, conducting live online classes, and focusing on communication skills for meetings, presentations, negotiations, and leadership contexts. The teacher will assess learner progress, provide detailed feedback, and adjust content to address evolving communication needs and business scenarios. Responsibilities also include maintaining accurate records of sessions, collaborating with the academic team to refine materials, and ensuring a consistent, professional learning experience. This is an online work position, and is open only to non-Brazilian candidates.

Requirements/Qualifications: (Please ONLY apply if you MEET ALL the following requisites)

-ACTIVE CNPJ is essential and mandatory

-FLUENT ENGLISH at teaching level with excellent grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation suitable for business environments.

-International TEACHING CERTIFICATION or graduation in Education, Languages, Linguistics, Business, or a related field; international teaching certificates (e.g., CELTA, TESOL).

-Proven solid EXPERIENCE teaching English to professionals or executives, with a focus on business or corporate communication.

-Proven experience with ONLINE TEACHING

-Ability to design and deliver personalized lesson plans based on learners’ job roles, industries, and real business situations.

-Skills in facilitating communication practice for meetings, presentations, negotiations, and leadership interactions.

-Comfort with online teaching tools, learning platforms, and digital resources to support interactive and engaging classes.

-Strong interpersonal skills, cultural awareness, and the ability to work with diverse, high-level professionals in a respectful, inclusive manner.

-Know how to use Google Meet and Notion for teaching

-Having a good computer setup and a stable internet connection
